title: rocKE monitor deploy settings
description: One deployment of the rocKE monitor in a container: the container, the repository, the host's share, the monitor, its features, the tools it works through and the models it may use (QUICK_DEPLOY_GUIDE.md). No secret, token or key goes in this file: rkmon login and rkmon secret set them.

schema_version.description: The version of this file's layout. A file in an older layout is moved to it when it is read.

container.title: Container
container.description: What this deployment's container is called and the image it runs.

name.description: The container's name: its volumes and its first image tag are named after it too. Each deployment on one host needs a name of its own (lowercase letters, digits, - and _).

image.title: Image
image.description: The image the container runs, as rkmon image load or rkmon image pull leaves it on this host.

name.description: The image's name, as the build settings' image.name named it: the container runs <name>:<tag>, and rkmon image load, pull, check, start and swap look for that image. Lowercase letters and digits, joined by . _ or -, parts separated by /; a registry goes in container.image.pull_registry. Blank: rocke-pr-monitor.

tag.description: The image's tag, as the image builder built it (the package's version, say). A new tag is how a new image is rolled out: load or pull it, then rkmon swap --tag TAG. Blank: container.name.

pull_registry.description: The registry rkmon image pull pulls <registry>/<name>:<tag> from. Blank: no registry; the image comes from a file (rkmon image load IMAGE_FILE).

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: The repository that holds rocKE, and the pull requests the monitor watches.

name.description: The GitHub repository that holds rocKE, as owner/name. Required.

path.description: rocKE's folder inside the repository. Required.

scope_labels.description: The pull-request labels that put a PR in scope; at least one is required.

path_labels.description: Broad labels that put a PR in scope only when its diff touches repository.path. Empty: none.

host.title: Host
host.description: The container's share of this host, its users' ids and your own mounts.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: The container's CPUs, memory and RAM disk.

cpus.description: The CPUs the container may use; the scaler keeps the parallel reviews and the parallel builds within them.

memory_gb.description: The container's memory limit in GB: at least ramdisk_gb plus 8.

ramdisk_gb.description: A RAM disk (tmpfs) for the reviews' worktrees and builds, in GB; it counts against memory_gb. 0: no RAM disk.

users.title: Users
users.description: The ids of the container's users: the monitor's and the GitHub writer's, each 1000 or more, not 65534, and neither the other's nor a PR runner's (the PR runners, one per slot, keep the package's ids).

monitor_uid.description: The user id the monitor runs as. Blank: yours (whoever runs rkmon).

monitor_gid.description: The monitor's group id. Blank: yours.

github_writer_uid.description: The id of the GitHub writer, the only user that reads the GitHub write login.

pr_runner_uid.description: Sets no user's id (the PR runners keep the package's ids); checked as the others are: 1000 or more, not 65534, and neither the monitor's nor the writer's.

mounts.description: More read-only mounts into the container, each HOST:CONTAINER:ro (an SSH key for remote GPU tests, say). Empty: none.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.description: The tick cycle and the orchestrator, shared by every feature.

tick_min.description: Minutes between two ticks; each reads GitHub, updates the queue and the plans, and hands the orchestrator what needs it.

full_tick_min.description: A full tick at least every this many minutes, even when nothing changed (an idle tick is one line). 0: every tick is full.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: The Claude session that runs the ticks, verifies, decides and posts.

model.description: Its model: a claude model (opus, sonnet, haiku, or a model_bindings entry whose provider is claude).

effort.description: How hard it thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

features.title: Features
features.description: What the monitor does. review_automation and merge_queue each run in prototype (everything computed and kept here, nothing sent) or live (they act on GitHub).

review_automation.title: Review automation
review_automation.description: A review of each new or changed pull request in scope: a first pass, then the verifier's check of every claim.

enabled.description: true: reviews run; false: no reviews, no review checks and no Claude session (ticks are acted on by rules).

mode.description: prototype: reviews are prepared and kept on this machine, nothing is posted; live: each verified review, and each overlap notice, is posted on its PR as integrations.github_cli.account.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: When a pull request's review starts.

push_cooldown_min.description: Minutes after a PR's newest push before it is reviewed, so a burst of pushes gets one review. 0: no wait.

follow_up_cooldown_min.description: Minutes between two follow-up reviews on one PR; a follow-up due sooner waits. 0: no wait.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: How much runs at once: starting points, which the scaler then moves by the machine's load.

parallel_reviews.description: Reviews prepared at once at the start, 1 to 5; the scaler then moves it within 1 to 5.

parallel_heavy_checks.description: Local builds and GPU tests at once at the start, 1 to 8; the scaler then moves it within 1 to 8.

large_prs.title: Large PRs
large_prs.description: What happens with very large pull requests.

manual_review_over_lines.description: A PR with more changed lines than this is never reviewed on its own: it waits for you to start it (rk review-start N).

split_part_lines.description: The most changed lines in one part when a large review is split into parts (rk review-split N).

passes.title: Passes
passes.description: Each review pass's model and effort. A model is opus, sonnet, haiku or a model_bindings entry; default (the optional passes) means the pass's owner does it, with the owner's model and effort.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: The verifier: the Claude agent that reviews blind, then reproduces or cuts each claim of the first pass and writes the post.

model.description: The verifier's model: a claude model (opus, sonnet, haiku, or a model_bindings entry whose provider is claude).

effort.description: The verifier's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: The code quality lane: the Claude agent that reviews each PR's design (single responsibility, one home per fact, layers, names, tests).

model.description: The quality lane's model: a claude model (opus, sonnet, haiku, or a model_bindings entry whose provider is claude).

effort.description: The quality lane's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

first_pass.title: First pass
first_pass.description: The draft of each review, before the verifier reads it.

model.description: Who drafts it. default: no separate pass; the verifier does it, with passes.verify's model and effort. A model: that model drafts, and the verifier checks each claim.

effort.description: The drafting model's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max for a claude model. default: passes.verify's effort. A model that is not Claude takes none: leave it default.

ci_triage.title: CI triage
ci_triage.description: The first read of a PR's failing CI jobs, for the verifier.

model.description: Who reads them first. default: no separate pass; the verifier does it, with passes.verify's model and effort. A model: that model hands the verifier leads, which it checks.

effort.description: That model's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max for a claude model. default: passes.verify's effort. A model that is not Claude takes none: leave it default.

quality_draft.title: Quality draft
quality_draft.description: The first read of a PR's diff by the code quality rules, for the quality lane.

model.description: Who reads it first. default: no separate pass; the quality lane does it, with passes.quality's model and effort. A model: that model hands the quality lane leads, which it checks.

effort.description: That model's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max for a claude model. default: passes.quality's effort. A model that is not Claude takes none: leave it default.

notice_draft.title: Notice draft
notice_draft.description: The first draft of an overlap or a drift notice, for the orchestrator.

model.description: Who drafts it. default: no separate pass; the orchestrator does it, with monitor.orchestrator's model and effort. A model: that model hands the orchestrator a draft and its leads, which it checks.

effort.description: That model's effort: low, medium, high, xhigh or max for a claude model. default: monitor.orchestrator's effort. A model that is not Claude takes none: leave it default.

merge_queue.title: Merge queue
merge_queue.description: The landing order of the PRs in scope, with its gates and its merge plan, computed every tick.

enabled.description: true: the queue, its gates, the merge plan and priority requests run; false: none of them.

mode.description: prototype: the plan, the gates and the order are computed and shown, and nothing is armed, held, commented or filed; live: the monitor acts on them (auto_merge, auto_hold, develop_guard, queue and drift notices).

auto_merge.description: enabled: a PR you cleared (rk clear N) gets GitHub's own auto-merge once it is validated (live only; GitHub's gates still decide); hints_only: the order is shown and proposed to you, and nothing is armed.

auto_hold.description: true: a PR whose gate failure is confirmed as its own is held with a change request until it is fixed and you re-approve it (live only); false: the failure is reported to you only.

develop_guard.description: true: develop is checked after every merge, and a break is traced to its PR; live: the break is filed as a GitHub issue (an incident when CI is red) and its fixes are linked; prototype: it is reported to you only. false: develop is not checked.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Your admin dashboard, and the team dashboard for other teams.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.description: Your page: everything the monitor shows, with Approve and Decline for priority requests and ticket drafts.

enabled.description: true: the admin dashboard is served; false: no web server, no dashboard.

port.description: The host port it is published on.

bind.description: The host address it is published on (where it listens and who can reach it: README.md, "The admin dashboard").

team.title: Team dashboard
team.description: The page for other teams: the admin dashboard without its admin controls, with a request box whose requests wait for your OK.

enabled.description: true: the team dashboard is delivered; false: none.

delivery.description: publish: pushed after every tick to a team web host (advanced publish.html; its key: rkmon secret webhost_ed25519); serve: served by this monitor at bind and port.

port.description: The host port it is served on (delivery serve).

bind.description: The host address it is served on (delivery serve): 127.0.0.1, this machine only; another address of this host, or 0.0.0.0 for all of them.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Messages to the team chat channel: a develop break with CI red and no fix planned, and the decisions on the Needs-you list.

enabled.description: true: the messages go to teams_channel; false: they wait on the dashboards and in the log.

teams_channel.description: The Teams channel's name, as the messages name it; required with alerts on. Its webhook is a secret: rkmon secret teams_webhook.

message_cooldown_min.description: The fewest minutes between two messages of the same kind (a develop break, the Needs-you list), each kind on its own clock; what comes up in between goes in the next one. 0: no wait.

ticket_creation.title: Ticket creation
ticket_creation.description: JIRA tickets, filed through the atlassian CLI, which it requires (integrations.atlassian_cli.jira_site).

enabled.description: true: tickets are filed for the triggers below; false: what would be ticketed is reported to you.

jira_project.description: The JIRA project key new tickets go to; required with ticket creation on.

default_epic.description: The key of the epic new tickets are linked to. Blank: no epic.

review_follow_up.description: true: a significant review item still open when its PR merged gets a follow-up ticket for the PR's author; false: it is listed for you.

out_of_scope_issue.description: true: an issue found outside any PR's review gets a ticket draft, filed when you approve it on the admin dashboard; false: it is reported to you only.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The tools the monitor works through; a feature that needs one requires its settings. Their tokens and keys are never here: rkmon login sets them.

github_cli.title: GitHub CLI
github_cli.description: GitHub, through gh: a read login for every tick and a write login for what the monitor posts.

account.description: The GitHub login the monitor acts as and takes instructions from (the operator); required. Its logins: rkmon login gh-read and rkmon login gh.

atlassian_cli.title: Atlassian CLI
atlassian_cli.description: JIRA and Confluence, through the atlassian CLI (its login: rkmon login atlassian); ticket creation requires it.

jira_site.description: The Atlassian site that holds the JIRA project, as the atlassian CLI names it (a site's name or its address); required with ticket creation on. Blank: the monitor uses no Atlassian site.

confluence_site.description: The Atlassian site the monitor's Confluence space is on. Blank: jira_site.

claude_code.title: Claude Code
claude_code.description: Claude Code, which runs the orchestrator and its agents and reaches every claude model (its login: rkmon login claude).

gateway.description: The address of the gateway Claude is reached through (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL). Blank: the one in the Claude login, else Anthropic's own API.

model_bindings.title: Model bindings
model_bindings.description: The models the passes may name, each by a name of your choice. Built in, with no entry: opus, sonnet and haiku, the latest Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5). A key is never here: api_key_secret names a secret installed with rkmon secret.

additionalProperties.description: One model: its provider, its id, and for a model outside Claude Code its endpoint, key and limits.

oneOf.title: claude
oneOf.description: A Claude model, reached through Claude Code and integrations.claude_code.gateway.

model_id.description: The model's id, as Claude Code names it (claude-opus-5-5, say).

oneOf.title: ollama
oneOf.description: A model on an Ollama server.

provider.description: ollama: a model an Ollama server runs.

model_id.description: The model's name, as ollama list shows it.

endpoint.description: The Ollama server's address (http://localhost:11434 on the same host).

max_parallel.description: Requests at once (one model in memory serves one well). 0: no cap.

timeout_min.description: Minutes a request may wait for an answer before it is sent again.

oneOf.title: openai-compatible
oneOf.description: A model behind an OpenAI-compatible chat completions route (an LLM gateway, vLLM, LiteLLM).

model_id.description: The model's name, exactly as the endpoint serves it.

endpoint.description: The endpoint's address, ending in its API base path (the chat route /chat/completions goes after it).

api_key_secret.description: The secret that holds the endpoint's key, installed with rkmon secret NAME FILE. Blank: no key.

limits.description: What the endpoint allows, shared by every pass that uses it.

requests_per_min.description: Requests a minute. 0: none known (an HTTP 429 still slows the callers).

timeout_min.description: Minutes a request may wait for an answer before it is sent again.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Any other configuration key, at its name in docs/internal_settings.md (worker, gpu, publish, drafter, ...). A key the sections above hold is refused here.

secrets.description: A secret's name to a file of yours that holds it (mode 600, outside the package): rkmon secret NAME reads it. Never the secret itself.

secret_values.description: A secret's name to its value, for tests; a real deployment names files under secrets instead.

setup.description: The setup's step choices (rk settings export writes them): the clone, the venvs, the private gh, the model check, the agentic files, the services.

exported_at.description: When rk settings export wrote this file.

package_version.description: The package version that wrote this file.
